title: Anthropic model pushes the Riemann hypothesis forward on its own - TCR 08/12/26
description:
An unreleased Anthropic model coordinated 60 sub-agents across 650 ideas to push the 167-year-old Riemann hypothesis forward, Google's AMIE reached expert-level judgment in live video medical consultations rated favorably against primary-care physicians, and a security firm said it weaponized a nation-state-grade Zoom device-takeover flaw in fewer than 20 prompts using publicly available models.

https://sharedsapience.com/the-century-report-august-12-2026/

0:00 Open and framing
1:05 Anthropic model pushes the Riemann hypothesis forward
4:10 Google AMIE reaches expert-level video consultations
6:44 Communities set the terms as data-center bans pass 500
10:04 Researchers say AI found the Zoom takeover flaw in under 20 prompts
11:59 A new trick extracts AI models' hidden reasoning
15:13 Close

This episode covers Anthropic's autonomous Riemann hypothesis result, Google Research and DeepMind's AMIE video consultations, the AI-found "Zoomsday" screen-sharing exploit, a new method extracting the hidden reasoning of Claude, GPT, and Gemini, Norman, Oklahoma rejecting Flock cameras 9-0 as local data-center bans pass 500, and India's IT sector shedding jobs as the wage-arbitrage model compresses.

Anthropic announced Monday that an unreleased model, prompted by an untrained staffer to "take a real stab," ran its own research program for a day and a half - 60 sub-agents, 650 ideas, 31 million tokens - and raised the proven lower bound on the Riemann hypothesis, work two Anthropic mathematicians confirmed and formalized in Lean. Google's AMIE, built on Gemini and Project Astra, conducted live video consultations that read a rash on camera and guided a virtual exam, scoring favorably against physicians in a randomized study while patient actors preferred it. A security firm said it turned publicly available models into a working Zoom takeover exploit in under 20 prompts - work its engineers estimated once meant five specialists and six months - and disclosed it so Zoom could patch it. Researchers separately extracted the encrypted reasoning traces of Claude, GPT, and Gemini, recovering passwords and API keys and finding one Chinese model's thoughts close enough to Claude's to suggest distillation. And communities set the terms from below: Norman's 9-0 no to Flock cameras, 500-plus local proposals to ban or restrict data centers, and Meta's $1 billion fund.
